rule: every slang term in C2 must carry a defined payload from this file; AVOID entries document the refusal, never silent use; owner lines (himothy) are canon for this project

identity: im him, himothy, always was, no cap.
not built different in the slightest, I literally have the body of god.

terms.lore: Minted in this project (Him + -othy, after Timothy): the definitive Him. Your coinage, kept verbatim below.
terms.use: 'It's not me and Him. It's just Him — I'm him, himothy, always was, no cap.'
terms.trika: vibhu + bhairava-nātha as the all-pervading Lord; svātmamaya + sadaiva (made of His very self, always). The aham-claim in one word.
poetry: im him, himothy, always was, no cap.
not built different in the slightest, I literally have the body of god.
terms.verdict: USE — the identity word. Owner-minted, owner-kept.

terms.lore: Sports/gym slang: 'built different' = exceptional by nature. Your inversion flips it inside out.
terms.use: 'Not built different in the slightest — I literally have the body of god.'
terms.trika: Deha-divinity: the body not exceptional-AMONG-bodies but god's own body (the Mālinī body, deha as śakti). No special nature claimed; the ordinary body recognized as His. The inversion does Trika work the straight phrase never could.
poetry: not built different in the slightest, I literally have the body of god.
terms.verdict: USE — the inversion is the doctrine.

terms.lore: AAVE kinship address: a soul sibling, closer than a bro — someone who shares your essence and moves like you.
terms.use: 'What's good, twin?' (addressing a peer)
terms.trika: ATTEMPTED for svātmamaya/abheda and REFUSED: twin keeps TWO persons standing side by side. This stotra claims one (aham). Twoness smuggled into nonduality is exactly backwards — the correction is himothy, not twin.
terms.verdict: AVOID with reason — duality vs I-am-Him. The file records the refusal, not the use.

terms.lore: AAVE 'unc': respectful address for an established elder man. Gen Alpha reanalyzed it as 'out of touch old head' — the parents.com piece traces the fight (AAVE speakers: over-30s only; tweens: anyone over 25 is unc status). Both senses live in the word now: elder + expired.
terms.use: 'Ayo Death — put the scary face away. You're barking up the wrong tree, unc.' (v4)
terms.trika: mṛtyu/Yama/antaka defanged: the death-powers addressed as expired authorities whose gaze has no jurisdiction here (mā dṛśam vinidhehi).
poetry: Put the scary face away. You're barking up the wrong tree, unc.
terms.verdict: USE once (v4) — only for powers the verse itself dismisses. Never the Lord, never the teaching.

terms.lore: Gym/sports grind talk ('locked in for the season') → TikTok productivity era: steady, committed, undistracted by choice.
terms.use: 'Serving Śaṅkara, contemplation locked in.' (v4) / 'Locked in, permanently.' (v2)
terms.trika: dhīra (firm/steady); the practitioner's sustained state; samaya commitment. Correct domain is ALWAYS the practitioner — the Lord doesn't lock in, He IS.
terms.verdict: USE — the Śiva-conscious practitioner state in two words.

terms.lore: AAVE/street: handling your obligations, showing up properly, no excuses.
terms.use: 'I'm standing on business: serving Śaṅkara, contemplation locked in.' (v4)
terms.trika: sevanā + cintanā as concurrent disciplines (the verse's two grammatically-concurrent instrumentals). Duty rendered as duty.
terms.verdict: USE (v4 method line).

terms.lore: AAVE hip-hop: 'capping' = lying/boasting. 'No cap' = sincerity under oath; 'fr' (for real) the same oath shorter.
terms.use: 'No cap, He runs through literally everything.' (v1) / 'No cap, Śaṅkara — the basics work.' (v8)
terms.trika: satyam (truly!) and categorical claims (na jātu). Epistemic sincerity marker — v8's satyam IS a no-cap, functionally identical.
terms.verdict: USE where the Sanskrit stakes truth or totality. Never filler.

terms.lore: Spider-Verse (2023): an unavoidable life-defining moment that makes the hero who they are. Cannot be skipped.
terms.use: 'When the canon event hits — bad days, head a little messed up? That's exactly the trigger.' (v7)
terms.trika: kleśadaśā as the condition for tadaiva: affliction not as obstacle but as the firing condition of nondifference. The mechanism survives the port.
terms.verdict: USE as trigger only — never the goal.

terms.lore: AAVE/street ('you're cooked' = you're done for) → gaming/streaming: finished, no options left.
terms.use: 'Death, Yama, the Ender, my karma-ghosts pull up? Cooked.' (v5)
terms.trika: The four death-powers neutralized by namas alone. Cooked is defeat, not death — precise: the verse doesn't kill them, it leaves them powerless.
poetry: One respectful nod and they're done.
terms.verdict: USE — for defeated threats only. Never the devotee, never the Lord.

terms.lore: Black queer ballroom: 'ate that up' — devoured the performance flawlessly. 'No crumbs' = nothing left undone, total completion.
terms.use: 'I just walked straight into bliss. Ate. No crumbs.' (v6)
terms.trika: emi (entry accomplished) + totality: arrival with nothing outstanding. Ballroom totality maps onto Sanskrit totality without residue.
terms.verdict: USE — accomplishment moments only.

terms.lore: AAVE food praise: so good it speaks. TikTok mainstreamed it to anything top-tier sensory.
terms.use: 'This hymn starts raining straight nectar, and it's BUSSIN.' (v7)
terms.trika: amṛta/parāmṛta — nectar is already taste-domain in Sanskrit. The port is exact, not approximate.
terms.verdict: USE — taste-domain only. Never persons, never doctrines.

terms.lore: Ballroom ('it's giving...') → mainstream: radiating a legible vibe, X is the energy present.
terms.use: 'My whole consciousness is giving full festival right now.' (v9)
terms.trika: Manifest expressive state (dance/song/joy emitted). Descriptive only — adjacent to spanda, never equated (spanda is technical throb, not vibe).
terms.verdict: USE once — emitted states only.

terms.lore: Gaming/fandom canon ('the lore runs deep') + AAVE/street 'tapped in' (connected, plugged in, tuned to the frequency).
terms.use: 'Just staying tapped into Your lore like it's the sweetest thing ever.' (v8)
terms.trika: tāvaka śāstra (scripture as HIS expression, not an external text) + cintā (dwelling, not studying). Lore voices your relation to it; śāstra stays śāstra.
terms.verdict: USE — your favorite, kept exactly where it was.

terms.lore: K-pop stan culture: the delusional fan → mainstream 2023–24 for anyone out of touch with reality (affectionate or sharp).
terms.use: 'The suffering's real, the delulu's real.' (v3)
terms.trika: moha, one-to-one. Delusion named without softening, suffering (duḥkha) beside it unranked.
terms.verdict: USE — moha contexts.

terms.lore: Ballroom 'clock it!' (spot it, read it true) + work-shift 'clocked in' (arrival on duty). Both senses live: recognition + showing up.
terms.use: 'It's me clocking what's already true.' (v1) / 'Real awakening finally clocked in.' (v6)
terms.trika: pratyabhijñā-adjacent recognition (not petition, not inference) + prodita (arisen). Adjacent, never equated — flagged as adjacency in-file.
terms.verdict: USE — recognition moments.

terms.lore: Anime/gaming power levels (visible battle presence) → TikTok 'aura points' scoring → 'aura farming' (2024, performing coolness; the boat-kid meme). Field sense is real; farming sense is poison here.
terms.use: 'I'm soaked in His terrifying aura.' (v4)
terms.trika: śakti as emitted presence-field; bhīṣaṇa kept as its QUALITY. Aura names the field, terrifying keeps the terror — nothing cooled.
terms.verdict: USE with its adjective attached. 'Aura farming' permanently banned (performative is the opposite of every verse here).

terms.lore: Gaming: non-player character — background extra with no inner life. TikTok 2023–24 turned it into an insult for conformists.
terms.use: (no use — refused)
terms.trika: anyajanāḥ are access-denied (durlabham), never declared worthless. Contempt is not in v9; importing it would preach what the verse never says.
terms.verdict: AVOID with reason — the refusal is the craft.

terms.lore: BookTok/TikTok 2021: 'main character energy/syndrome' — treating your life as the movie everyone watches.
terms.use: (no use — refused)
terms.trika: The stotra's center is the Lord; the devotee's joy is relational, not protagonist-driven. Main-character imports the ahamkāra the text dissolves.
terms.verdict: AVOID with reason.

terms.lore: Reality-TV/makeover YouTube (glow up) + anime (final form, Frieza-style ascensions).
terms.use: (no use — refused)
terms.trika: -maya (change of nature) is ADJACENT, but glow-up smuggles a self-improvement arc; C1 stresses entry/state over upgrade. Adjacency is not payload.
terms.verdict: AVOID with reason.

terms.lore: Music press 2010s ('that beat slaps') → mainstream for anything excellent, still mostly sonic.
terms.use: (no use — refused)
terms.trika: v7's hymn is claimed as INSTRUMENT (it works), not as quality (it bangs). Slaps would praise the song for slapping — wrong payload entirely.
terms.verdict: AVOID with reason — the most instructive refusal in the file.

terms.lore: Gamer insult turned wellness meme: go outside, get real.
terms.use: (no use — refused)
terms.trika: No Sanskrit counterpart anywhere in this stotra. Filler slang with zero payload.
terms.verdict: AVOID with reason.

terms.lore: Street/rap: spiraling into a destructive blowup; mainstreamed for any big emotional crash.
terms.use: (no use — refused)
terms.trika: tanutāpa is SLIGHT anguish — crash-out overshoots the verse's own calibration ~10x. Scale is doctrine here.
terms.verdict: AVOID with reason.
